lecture_notes.pdf.title: Software Project Management Lecture Notes
lecture_notes.pdf.summary: These lecture notes cover core concepts in software project management, including step-wise planning, PRINCE2 principles, and PMBOK knowledge areas. They also explain cost-benefit analysis and resource allocation for managing IT and software projects.

unit1_Lec.pdf.title: Project Management Monitoring and Control
unit1_Lec.pdf.summary: These lecture notes cover the fundamentals of monitoring and control in project management, detailing their purpose, key activities, and challenges. They also introduce techniques such as Earned Value Analysis for tracking project progress and performance.

unit2_SPM_niotes.pdf.title: SPM_Unit-2_notes
unit2_SPM_niotes.pdf.summary: These lecture notes cover foundational software project management concepts, including step-wise planning, the PRINCE2 methodology, PMBOK guidelines, and cost-benefit analysis. Despite the file naming, the content focuses on project management principles rather than the core course units.

unit4_SPM_notes.pdf.title: Unit 4 Project Monitoring and Control Notes
unit4_SPM_notes.pdf.summary: These lecture notes cover project monitoring and control principles, including progress tracking, risk management, and Earned Value Analysis. They also address common project challenges like communication breakdowns and resource constraints.

It provides a comprehensive overview of the curriculum covering foundations, frameworks, multi-agent systems, safety, and deployment.
